'''Circarpousian water snakes''', also known more simply as '''Circarpian snakes''', were large predators native to the [[Circarpous system/Legends|Circarpous Major system]] and [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Mimban/Legends|Mimban]] that produced edible [[Egg/Legends|eggs]].

The [[Shi'ido]] [[Mammon Hoole]] once transformed into the form of one of these [[Snake/Legends|snakes]] in order to escape from shackles during [[Prison/Legends|imprisonment]] in [[Jabba's Palace/Legends|Jabba's Palace]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].
